description: This source file implements a command-line utility that dispatches calls to either 'hostapd_main' or 'wpa_supplicant_main' based on the name used to invoke the program. It replaces the process name to determine which underlying service to run, supporting a multicast-like call structure to manage multiple services from a single binary.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point that dispatches execution to either 'hostapd_main' or 'wpa_supplicant_main' based on the invocation name. It can restart itself with different parameters based on command-line arguments.
